description.value: Windsor Cafe is a Tudor-style heritage building in Oak Bay, steps from the Oak Bay Marina and Windsor Park, offering locally sourced comfort food, fair-trade organic coffee roasted in Nanaimo, BC wines, and local craft beers from Hoyne and Phillips Brewing. Opened in 2018 by a husband-and-wife team, it features three indoor dining rooms and two outdoor garden patios with 50 seats overlooking Windsor Park. The rotating seasonal lunch menu and takeout options make it a practical and atmospheric stop for cyclists exploring the Oak Bay waterfront.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (8 spaces) at 27m. Total: 8 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is rich and corroborates OSM contact details (phone 778-440-2540, address 2540 Windsor Rd, V8S 5H3). Takeout is explicitly confirmed across multiple website pages ('takeout menu options', 'takeout coffees', 'takeout pastries'). No bike-specific amenities (rack, pump, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so those remain null. OSM hours omit Monday but the website prominently states 'Now open Mondays!' — flagged as a stale OSM tag.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag (Tu-Fr 08:30-17:00, Sa-Su 09:00-17:00) omits Monday, but the website prominently states 'Now open Mondays! 8:30 AM – 5:00 PM' — OSM hours appear stale.
OSM addr:city is 'Oak Bay' while website footer uses 'Victoria, BC'; Oak Bay is its own municipality so both are technically correct, but worth noting for directory consistency.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, well-established cafe steps from the Oak Bay Marina and a popular waterfront cycling corridor; takeout confirmed, making it a practical stop for touring cyclists.
